# Tarot Flower

> Tarot Flower is an evergreen Tarot and astrology library and the home of Vanessa Hylande's Sacred Becoming system, ritual and embodiment practices, original imagery, and related authored resources.

Vanessa Hylande is the creator and author behind Tarot Flower and Sacred Becoming; Tarot Flower is the site and publisher. The Goddess Embodiment methodology page below provides an on-site introduction to Vanessa and her work.

Divine Feminine is the broader conceptual territory. Goddess Embodiment is Vanessa's methodology for bringing archetype, body, mind, spirit, and creative practice into lived experience. Embodiment runs throughout Tarot Flower, including Tarot, Goddess work, ritual, and Sacred Becoming; it is not confined to one collection.

Sacred Becoming is Vanessa's authored transformational and alchemical system. FIRE and the Sacred Becoming Oracle Deck are distinct works within it; Sacred Becoming Mentorship is a separate one-to-one service associated with the system. FIRE and the physical Oracle Deck are currently forthcoming.

## Tarot

- [Tarot Card Meanings](https://tarotflower.com/tarot-card-meanings/): Main doorway to the 78 cards, their meanings, and the Major and Minor Arcana.
- [Understanding the Tarot](https://tarotflower.com/understanding-the-tarot/): How archetype, number, element, symbol, and story connect the deck.
- [Major Arcana](https://tarotflower.com/major-arcana/): The 22 archetypes and links to their individual card interpretations.
- [Minor Arcana](https://tarotflower.com/minor-arcana/): The four suits, their elemental associations, and everyday themes.

## Astrology and Moon

- [Astrology](https://tarotflower.com/astrology/): Zodiac signs, planetary archetypes, and connections between astrology and Tarot.
- [Moon Magic](https://tarotflower.com/moon-magic-spells/): Lunar ritual and practice, with links to altars, spells, and related writings.

## Goddess and Embodiment

- [Goddess Mythology](https://tarotflower.com/goddess-mythology/): Goddess stories and symbolism, contemporary embodiment practices, and distinct Oracle interpretations.
- [Divine Feminine](https://tarotflower.com/tag/divine-feminine/): The broader collection of Goddess, embodiment, archetype, movement, and reflection material.
- [Goddess Embodiment](https://tarotflower.com/goddess-embodiment-practices/): Vanessa Hylande's methodology, creator background, and connections to Tarot, ritual, and lived practice; not a standalone course or service.

## Sacred Becoming

- [Sacred Becoming](https://tarotflower.com/sacred-becoming/): The system's symbolic doorway: the five-element amulet and Space, Embodiment, Transmutation, Emergence, and Divine Union.
- [Elemental Rituals](https://tarotflower.com/rituals/): Overview of the elemental ritual works and their current availability.
- [Step Into Your Fire](https://tarotflower.com/step-into-your-fire/): Vanessa's guided FIRE ritual for courage and confidence, with a companion guide; currently coming soon.
- [Sacred Becoming Oracle Deck](https://tarotflower.com/sacred-becoming/oracle-deck/): Vanessa's Oracle work, its origin and spiral of transformation, and the waitlist for the forthcoming physical deck.
- [Sacred Becoming Mentorship](https://tarotflower.com/sacred-becoming/mentorship/): Private one-to-one service with Vanessa through eight thresholds, including her first-person account of the work's foundations.

## Evergreen Collections

- [The Witch's Journal](https://tarotflower.com/daily-tarot/): Living library of stories, rituals, mythology, embodiment, Tarot, lunar practice, and personal reflections.
- [Twin Flames and Relationships](https://tarotflower.com/tag/love/): Vanessa's spiritual and personal relationship writing, including recognition, separation, intimacy, boundaries, and reflection.

## Resources and Ways to Work

- [Goddess Embodiment Guide](https://tarotflower.com/10-steps-to-embody-the-goddess-free-download/): Free email-delivered resource introducing ritual, Tarot, movement, meditation, and reflection.
- [Readings with Vanessa](https://tarotflower.com/readings-with-vanessa/): Private live online Tarot readings, distinct from mentorship.
- [Tarot Flower Homepage](https://tarotflower.com/): Vanessa's welcome and the site's current library, ritual, resource, and service doorways.
